src: overlapping one-cell-thick rectangular frames on the background
dst: concentric square frame layers from outermost to innermost
match_cond: rank(s.color in the unique directed crossing path) == rank(d from outermost to innermost)
transform: reconstruct each frame from its visible-pixel bbox; add A->B when B is visible at a crossing of the two frame perimeters; redraw each ordered color as one nested one-cell-thick ring
grid_shape: square of side 2N-1, where N is the number of frame colors
